content: Mo Lep Barnabas Kǝ Sool

Nɗǝǝn kuur kǝ nenseet nɗang Jesu ɗe mon Antiyok, ɓǝ pak nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo, kǝ nenkam-kám mo ɗi. Barnabas, kǝ Simiyon ɗe mo kǝ pet wur a ɗetǝp, kǝ Lusiyus ngu Sairin, kǝ Manayen ɗewur wurang ashak kǝ mishkoom Herot, kǝ Sool.
Kaaɗe mon nkaa seyil nDaa ɗang mon nkaa yaa pwoo kǝ neen zak, ɓǝ Riin Ɗeɓang sat nǝnee, <<Wu bǝlǝp Barnabas kǝ Sool wu le nghan, mbǝ ɗak ɗe an kǝn mpet mo mbǝ cìn nǝ.>>
Ɓǝ mo yaa pwoo kǝ neen, ɗang mo ɗangnaan zak, ɓǝ mo lesar nkaa mo, ɓǝ mo ɓwet Barnabas kǝ Sool mo shinseet.
Mo Satpwoo Mǝ Naan nSaiprus
Riin Ɗeɓang lep Barnabas kǝ Sool mo shindǝm nSelusiya, ɓǝ mo dǝm ɗel tii mpeemǝnǝ, kǝ mo dǝm ɗe nSaiprus.
Kaaɗe mo wul nSalamis, ɓǝ mo satpwoo mǝ Naan ngurum mo nɗǝǝn lu mǝ Naan mǝ nnen Yahudi mo. Joon ɗe sǝm wur a Maak sǝ, wur ɗe ashak kǝ mo mbǝ ɓam.

Aɓwoon ɗe mo kǝ mwaan nɗǝǝn yil ɗe Am kuur neer nǝ cǝǝrkaat jir ɓǝ, mo dǝm wul mPafos, ɓǝ mo kat mee ngu Yahudi ɗe mo kǝ petsǝm wur a Barjesu wur a ngucìn yen ɗebish, kǝzak wur leshin a koo ngusatpwoo mǝ Naan sǝ, ɗang baa wur a ngusatpwoo Naan kas.
Wur ɗi ashak kǝ nguɗak mǝ ngwe ɗeɗes nǝ, gofna Sarjiyus Polo, wur a mee ngumanshii mbii zam. Gofna nǝ wur pet Barnabas kǝ Sool, mbǝɗe wur reɓet kǝlǝng pwoo mǝ Naan pǝ mo ɗi.
Ɗangɓe Elimas nguyen ɗebish sǝ, (A sǝm wur nǝ mmǝnǝ shi liispwoo mǝ Heleni) wur cíi mmo, mbǝɗe wur rǝɓet kǝ taji gofna nǝ wur shinzeen mpwoo mǝ Naan kas.
Ɗangɓe Sool ɗe moo pet wur a Pool, wur gam kǝ Riin mǝ Naan, ɓǝ wur ban yit fǝn nzǝng nkaa ngucìn yen ɗebish nǝ,

ɓǝ wur sat nǝnee, <<Waa làa mǝ ngunjwaan! Gha a shaarlek mǝ mbii ɗe ndǝre mo jir. Kǝzak pǝtuup fwaa nǝ gam kǝ gwampee, kǝ cìn nyang. Aa ɗaar shidaar-shidaar, mbǝkǝ nghan cǝǝr kǝ zeen mǝ Daa, mbǝkǝ nǝ ɗee ɗi a ɗung.
A naa yaksǝ, Daa Naan wur mbǝ le kǝ gha ɗee a vum. Baa gha mmak naa puus kas, mbǝ reppee lee.>> Abet-abet, ɓǝ vuun, kǝ peenkwoo mo jì paa Elimas, ɓǝ wur ɗoom yappee, mbǝ yap ngwe ɗe mbǝ yaakam nwur.
Kaaɗe gofna nǝ wur naa mbii aapwoo mǝnǝ, ɓǝ wur shinzeen, mbǝɗe nǝ fes aapwoo nwur nkaa kám ɗewur kǝlǝng nkaa Daa Naan.
Pool Kǝ Shaarmwaan Fin Mo nYil Antiyok
Pool kǝ nnen ɗe mo ashak kǝ wur, mo yool mPafos, ɓǝ mo ɗel nɗǝǝn tii, kǝ mo dǝm ɗi mPaga ɗe nǝ nyil mPamfiliya, ɓǝ Joon Maak yit mo mpeemǝnǝ, kǝ nwur baa dǝm ɗi nJerusalem.
Mo yool mPaga, ɓǝ mo ɗel dǝm Antiyok ɗe nǝ mPisidiya. Parpuus Nookɗi, ɓǝ mo ɗel nɗǝǝn lu mǝ Naan, ɓǝ mo tong ɗi.

Aɓwoon ɗe mee gurum kǝ tang nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt-haal mǝ Wàar mǝ Mosis mo, kǝ nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt-haal mǝ nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo, ɓǝ nen ɗǝnan-nan nkaa lu mǝ Naan nǝ, mo lep sat mmo nǝnee, <<Ɗyemnaa mo, katɗang wun kǝ mee pwoo ɗe wun mbǝ sat ngurum nǝ mo, ɓǝ wu sat.>>
Pool yool ɗar atǝng, ɓǝ wur ɗiyeep sar wur, mbǝkǝ ngurum nǝ mo ɗok ɗe tǝtǝk, ɓǝ wur sat nǝnee, <<Wun nnen Isreil mo, kǝ wun nen ɗe baa wun a nnen Isreil mo kas, ɗe wuu kǝǝr Naan, wu lekom fuu mo.
Naan mǝ nnen Isreil mo, bǝlǝp puun fun mo ɗang wur le mo a ɗeɗes, ɓǝ mo a mǝzep nɗǝǝn yil Ijip. Wur put kǝ mo nɗǝǝn yil Ijip shiɓal fin ɗeɗes zak.
Mbǝ ɓit mo laarfeer, ɓǝ wur mang gung kǝ mo a naaryil.
Wur le kǝ mmo twe mee soon mo pwoovǝl nɗǝǝn yil nKeenan, ɓǝ wur shin yil mǝnǝ nnen fin Isreil mo, ɓǝ nǝ ɗee mo a mbii kok kop. Mo tong nɗǝǝn yil mǝnǝ mbǝ ɓit mo kambil feer kǝ laarpaat.
Aɓwoon mǝnǝ, ɓǝ wur shin nentokɗyeel mo mmo, dǝm jì wul mɓít mǝ ngusatpwoo mǝ Naan Samuwel.
Kaaɗe mo ɗang pǝ Naan kǝ nwur shin mishkoom mmo, ɓǝ Naan shin Sool làa mǝ Kish mmo, ɗewur a ɗang mǝ Benjamin. Sool se mishkoom nǝ mbǝ ɓit mo laarfeer.

Aɓwoon ɗe Naan shang Sool mɓut nɗak mishkoom nǝ. Ɓǝ wur bǝlǝp Devit kǝ nwur ɗee a mishkoom mo. Naan shin langtǝng nkaa Devit nǝnee, <An kǝn nkat Devit làa mǝ Jese, a ngwe ɗe wen nreɓet hakyeng. Wur mbǝ cin mbii ɗe nsat mo nwur jir.>
A nɗǝǝn ɗang mǝ gwar ɗe ɗesǝ, ɓǝ Naan jì kǝ Jesu Nguɓam mbǝ nnen Isreil mo, kaaɗe gyet Naan kǝ ten tuweer mmo sǝ.
Akuɗang Jesu jì, ɓǝ Joon kǝ ten satpwoo Naan nnen Isreil mo jir nǝnee, <Mo tuwap, mbǝkǝ mmo cin baptisma ɗi mmo zak.>

Kaaɗe Joon kus kǝ kyes ɗak fin, ɓǝ wur tal pǝ gurum nǝ mo nǝnee, <Wun, pǝpan nǝ, an a wii? Baa a an a ngwe ɗe wun mbǝ ɗarnaa jì wur kas. Ɗangɓe wu lekom, mee gurum mbǝ jì aɓwoon fen, ɗe koo a teng kwoopshi ɗe nshii wur mo, ɓǝ baa ɗeret fen nǝ mak kǝ nghan fwen teng kwoopshi wur nǝ mo kas.>
<<Ɗyemnaa mo! Jep mǝ ɗang Abraham mo, kǝ nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas, ɗe mo kǝ kǝǝr Naan nɗǝǝn wun. A mbǝ wun jir, ɓǝ Naan kǝ lep pwoo ɓam ɗesǝ nǝ jì.

Nen ɗe mo kǝ tong nɗǝǝn Jerusalem kǝ nennan fur mo, baa mo man nǝ, Jesu a Nguɓam kas, kǝzak baa mo manshii mǝ pwoo nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo, ɗe mo kǝ tang koo a parpuus Nookɗi ɗeɗangyii kas zak. Gyet mo gampwoo ɗe gyet nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo kǝ ten sat kaaɗe gyet mo tokɗyeel muut nJesu sǝ.
Koo ɗe baa gyet mo kat wur cìn mee shikbish ɗe nǝ mak muut nwur kas, ɓǝ mo ɗang pǝ Pailet kǝ mmo tu wur ɗi.
Kaaɗe mbii ɗe mo kǝ ten nran nkaa wur mo gam jir, ɓǝ mo sham kǝ kúm wur nkaa shiyeepyoom nǝ, ɓǝ mo dǝm le kúm wur nɗǝǝn gwoot kǝcir.
Ɗangɓe Naan yool kǝ wur a peemúut.
Mbǝ meeteer mo ɗes, ɓǝ wur woo shin fin nnen ɗe gyet mo kǝ mwaan ashak kǝ wur, yool nGalili jì nJerusalem. Yaksǝ ɓǝ mo ɗee a langtǝng wur pǝ gurum mo ɗi.
Mmun, muu satpwoo ɗeret nwun, a pwoo ɗe gyet Naan kǝ ten cweer mpuun fun mo.
Naan kǝgam pǝ mun jep mo mo nɗesǝ, kaaɗe wur yool kǝ Jesu a peemúut. Ɗesǝ nǝ nciit kǝ mbii ɗe mo kǝ ten ran nɗǝǝn Zabura ɗevǝl sǝ nǝnee, <Gha a Làa fen, cicinsǝ an kǝn ɗee a puun fwaa.>
A pwoo ɗe Naan sat nkaa yool wur a peemúut nɗesǝ nǝnee, <Baa wur mbǝ baa cam muut ɗe zak kas> Kǝzak Naan sat zak nǝnee, <An mbǝ le ɗeret ɗe nǝ azeen-zeen nkaa wun, ɗe gyet kǝn ten ncweer nDevit.>
Kǝzak, wur sat nɗǝǝn mee Zabura nǝnee, <Baa gha mmak yit kǝ ngwe fwaa ɗeɓang wam nɗǝǝn kǝcir kas.>
<<Gyet Devit kǝ cìn ɗak nciit kǝ ɗyen mǝ Naan mɓít fin mo, ɓǝ wur muut, ɓǝ mo wum wur ashak kǝ puun fin mo, ɓǝ wur wam.
Ɗang Jesu ɗe Naan kǝ yool kǝ wur a peemúut, baa wur wam nɗǝǝn kǝcir kas.
Mbǝ mǝnǝ ɗyemnaa mo! Wu man nǝ, a mbǝ ɗeret mǝ gwar ɗesǝ nǝ, ɓǝ mun nkaa leshap nwun nkaa fwo mǝ shikbish fuu mo.
A mbǝ Jesu zak, ɗang koo ngwe ɗeɗangyii ɗewur shinzeen, ɓǝ wur mbǝ kat ɓam nɗǝǝn shikbish mo jir. Ɗangɓe baa Wàar Mosis nǝ mo mak ɓam wun mɓut shikbish fuu mo kas.
Mbǝ mǝnǝ, wu tap kǝ káa fuu mo, kǝ taji mbii ɗe gyet nensatpwoo mǝ Naan mo sat nǝ sham taa nkaa wun kas. Gyet mo sat nǝnee,

<Wu lekom, wun nenɓákpee mo, nǝn aapwoo nwun, ɗang wu mmurep. Mbǝɗǝ an mbǝ cìn mee ɗak nɗǝǝn teer fuu mo, ɗak ɗe baa wun mbǝ shínzeen nnǝ kas, koo dǝɓen. Koo ɗe mee gurum leshap nwun nkaa nǝnee, ɓǝ baa wun mbǝ shínzeen kas.> >>
Kaaɗe Pool kǝ Barabbas mo a ar put nɗǝǝn lu mǝ Naan nǝ, ɓǝ gurum nǝ mo ɗang pǝ mo, mbǝkǝ mmo cin leshap ɗi nkaa mbii ɗe mo kǝ sat mo, parpuus Nookɗi ɗe mbǝ jì zak.

Ɓǝ aɓwoon ɗe gurum mo rangkáa a peekuur nǝ, ɓǝ nnen Yahudi mo ɗes, kǝ nnen ɗe mo kǝ ciir ɗee a nnen Yahudi mo. Nen ɗe moo lepyit nkaa Naan, mo seet nɗang Pool kǝ Barnabas. Yaksǝ Pool kǝ Barnabas mo leshap mmo, shínɓal mmo mputuup, mbǝkǝ mmo mwaan ɗi nɗǝǝn ɗeret mǝ Naan.
Kaaɗe parpuus Nookɗi nǝ jì wul, ɓǝ nen pee nkaam nǝ mo ɗes hakyeng mo baaji kuur, mbǝ kǝlǝng pwoo mǝ Naan nǝ, ɗee rep pak mo nɗǝǝn pee nkaam nǝ a lee ɗak.
Ɗangɓe kaaɗe nnen Yahudi mo naa gurum mo kuur ɗes, ɓǝ pǝtuup mo mo gam kǝ zuur zam, nǝ le mmo sat nǝ, mbii ɗe Pool sat nǝ mo a ɗung, ɗang mo leshap ɗebuu nkaa wur zak.

Yaksǝ Pool kǝ Barnabas mo waa sǝǝt leshap nǝ ɓalɓal agaak baa kǝ mee kǝǝrmuut kas. Mo sat nǝnee, <<Nǝ a tǝng kǝ mo shee satpwoo mǝ Naan nǝ a nwun, ɗang wu ciipwoo Naan nǝ, kǝzak wu lesuk a koo baa wun kǝkoop nǝ mbǝ kat seen ɗe dǝm nghaa-nghaa kas. Ɓǝ yaksǝ, mun mbǝ yit wun, mbǝkǝ mmun dǝm mu satpwoo mǝ Naan nǝ ɗe nnen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas.
Mbǝɗǝ Daa kǝ sat mmun nǝnee, <An kǝn le gha, mbǝkǝ nghan ɗee a peeɓang mbǝ nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas. Mbǝkǝ nɗǝǝn gha, ɓǝ gurum ɗe nɗǝǝn yil nǝ mo jir, mo mbǝ kat ɓam ɗi.> >>
Kaaɗe nen ɗe baa mo a nnen Yahudi mo kas, mo kǝlǝng pwoo mǝnǝ, ɓǝ mo kǝlǝng retnyit zam, kǝzak mo lepwoo mǝ Naan a ɗeɗes. Nen ɗe mo kǝ ten bǝlǝp mo le, mbǝkǝ mmo kat seen ɗe dǝm nghaa-nghaa ɗi.
Pwoo kǝ Daa Naan nǝ dǝm shipee-shipee nɗǝǝn yil mǝnǝ jir.

Ɗangɓe nnen Yahudi mo kar pak shurep ɗe mo kǝǝr Naan, shurep ɗǝnan-nan mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mǝ pee nkaam nǝ mo, kǝ mmo shinjeel ɗe nkaa Pool kǝ Barnabas. Ɗangɓe mo ceen Pool kǝ Barnabas put aku nɗǝǝn yil mo.
Ɓǝ Pool kǝ Barnabas mo ɓwap ǝrong ɗe nǝn nkaa shii mo mo, mbǝkǝ nǝ ɗee ɗi a langtǝng nkaa nen pee nkaam nǝ mo, ɓǝ mo dǝm Ikoniyum.
Nenseet nɗang Jesu mo gam kǝ retnyit zam, ɗang mo gam kǝ Riin mǝ Naan zak.
